crear.selecciona_el_tipo_de: Select the evaluation type according to the SCA CVA v2 methodology.
crear.participaras_como_catador: Will you take part as a cupper?
crear.tu_evaluacion_contara_igual: Your evaluation will count equally in the panel's trimmed mean.

combinado.evaluacion_hedonica_general_de: Overall hedonic evaluation of the sample
combinado.al_marcar_un_tipo: Marking a type counts at least one defective cup.

extrinseco.ej_72_h_de: E.g. 72 h fermentation in a closed tank, dried on raised beds for 18 days
extrinseco.ej_contrato_directo_10: E.g. Direct trade, 10 bags of 69 kg
extrinseco.ej_lote_ganador_de: E.g. Regional competition winning lot; selective picking of ripe cherries

completa.la_evaluacion_extrinseca_es: The extrinsic evaluation is individual: your origin, process and trading data have been saved.
completa.gracias_por_completar_la: Thank you for completing the session. Ask the organizer if you need to confirm your evaluation was recorded.
completa.los_resultados_se_consolidan: Results are consolidated once everyone submits their sheets. From monitoring you can see progress or close the panel.
completa.para_proteger_la_evaluacion: To protect the blind evaluation, cuppers can't see scores until the organizer consolidates the panel.

progreso.esperando_a_que_los: Waiting for the others to finish...

resultados.haz_clic_en_una: Tap a sheet to see its details.
resultados.sin_puntaje_cva_faltan: No CVA score: the sheet is missing qualities or the overall impression.
resultados.la_ficha_escaneada_no: The scanned sheet was not found.
resultados.este_catador_aun_no: This cupper hasn't submitted any sheets yet.
resultados.sin_datos_de_atributos: No attribute data for this sample.
resultados.los_resultados_se_consolidan: Results are consolidated once all cuppers submit their sheets. From monitoring you can see who is missing, close samples or close the panel.
resultados.haz_clic_en_una_2: Tap a sample to see its panel average on the gauge.
resultados.sin_fichas_muestra_s: No sheets: {{p0}} sample(s) closed without evaluations.
resultados.participacion_y_consistencia_individual: Individual participation and consistency within the panel. Select a cupper to see their report.
resultados.el_consolidado_descarta_el: The consolidation drops the highest and lowest value per sample when there are 5 or more sheets.
resultados.promedio_de_la_impresion: Average Overall Impression per sample. Tap a sample to see its votes.
resultados.cuantos_catadores_eligieron_cada: How many cuppers chose each point on the scale (Overall Impression).
resultados.esta_muestra_no_recibio: This sample received no Overall Impression votes.
resultados.promedio_del_panel_en: Panel average on the hedonic scale (1 to 9).
resultados.promedio_del_panel_015: Panel average (0–15). Each cell's shade is proportional to the intensity.
resultados.esta_sesion_no_tiene: This session has no technical sheets recorded.
resultados.consolidacion_mediante_promedio_recortad: Consolidated with the SCA trimmed mean (highest and lowest dropped with 5 or more cuppers).
resultados.consolidacion_mediante_promedio_simple: Consolidated with a simple average (fewer than 5 sheets per sample).
resultados.participacion_y_consistencia_individual_: Individual participation and consistency within the panel.
resultados.como_quieres_exportar_tu: How do you want to export your PDF?
resultados.desmarca_a_los_catadores: Untick uncalibrated cuppers: their sheets won't be used in the PDF.
resultados.en_la_ventana_de: In the print window choose "Save as PDF".

hoja.formato_modificado_para_pacamaraqs: Form adapted for PacamaraQs, based on the SCA Coffee Value Assessment (Version 2, June 2024). Not an official SCA document.
hoja.esta_sesion_no_tiene: This session has no technical sheets recorded.
hoja.intensidades_promedio_descriptores_union: {{p0}} Intensities: average · Descriptors: union of all sheets · Tastes, texture and defects: majority (> 50%) · Circles: integer closest to the average.
hoja.promedio_recortado_sca_se: SCA trimmed mean (highest and lowest dropped).
hoja.promedio_simple_de_las: Simple average of the selected sheets.

escaner.modo_prueba_no_hay: Test mode: no AI key configured; the analysis returns simulated data.
escaner.revisa_que_coincidan_con: Check that they match the paper sheet before saving.

escaner.no_tienes_sesiones_en: You have no ongoing sessions where you take part as a cupper. For a single sheet use

escaner.se_guardara_como_una: It will be saved as a 1-sample personal session and you'll see its results.
escaner.toma_la_ficha_completa: Capture the whole sheet, straight on and with good light.

monitoreo.reconectando_el_progreso_se: Reconnecting… progress refreshes every few seconds meanwhile.
monitoreo.lleva_a_todos_los: Take all cuppers to the same sample.
monitoreo.por_evaluacion_ciega_solo: Because the evaluation is blind you only see progress, never scores. A cupper disconnected for more than 45 s is removed automatically if they haven't submitted all their sheets.
